# SIDECUT

> > Premium ski and snowboard tuning tools and educational resources from Whistler, founded by Chris Hillier.

SIDECUT specializes in professional-grade tuning equipment including the True Bar, Diamond Guides, and Panzer File, alongside comprehensive tutorials featuring Olympic skier Daron Rahlves. The company serves athletes, coaches, and DIY enthusiasts across North America, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand.

## Key Topics

- ski tuning
- edge sharpening
- base repair
- P-tex repair
- Diamond Stones
- Diamond Discs
- True Bar
- side edge tuning
- base edge tuning
- edge bevel
- Panzer File
- Chris Hillier
- Daron Rahlves
- snowboard tuning
- carving technique

## Getting Started

- [Sidecut Ski Snowboard Cross Country tuning tools](https://sidecut.com): Homepage featuring tuning kits, tools, and mission statement
- [Learn to Tune Your Skis | Ski Tuning Series by Sidecut](https://sidecut.com/new-learn-to-tune-series.html): Step-by-step video series for beginners on waxing and edge care
- [Tuning Tutorials - SIDECUT](https://sidecut.com/tuning-tutorials.html): Tutorial hub featuring waxing, base repair, and Daron Rahlves tips
- [Popular Ski Tuning Tutorials | Learn Ski Maintenance Like a Pro | Sidecut](https://sidecut.com/popular-ski-tuning-tutorials.html): Curated collection of most-viewed waxing and edge sharpening tutorials
- [Frequently Asked Questions - SIDECUT](https://sidecut.com/FAQS.html): FAQ covering shipping, product quality, and DIY tuning questions

## Tuning Guides

- [Tuning Instructions - SIDECUT](https://sidecut.com/tuning-instructions.html): Comprehensive tuning guide covering base repair and edge maintenance
- [Side Edge Tuning - SIDECUT](https://sidecut.com/side-edge-tuning.html): Guide to side edge tuning with Diamond Guides, Files, and Stones
- [Base Edge Tuning - SIDECUT](https://sidecut.com/base-edge-tuning.html): Base bevel tuning tutorial using WC Base-Edge File and guides
- [Ski Base Repair Instructions - SIDECUT](https://sidecut.com/ski-base-repair-instructions.html): Detailed P-tex base repair instructions with tool recommendations
- [Ski Base Repair Instructions - SIDECUT](https://us.sidecut.com/ski-base-repair-instructions.html): P-tex repair guide for fixing gouges with True Bar and Panzer File
- [Practical Ski Tuning Tips & Videos | Expert Guidance by Sidecut](https://sidecut.com/tuning-tips-videos.html): Video collection of practical tuning tips and techniques
- [Topsheet and Sidewall Preparation - SIDECUT](https://sidecut.com/top-sheet-and-sidewall-preparation.html): Advanced guide to topsheet shaping and sidewall removal for edge access
